claim: Government has announced a 10,000 monthly scholarship for all college students.
ISRO successfully launches its earth observation satellite EOS-08 aboard the SSLV-D3 rocket.
RBI announces that Rs 500 currency notes with the green strip near the Governor signature are fake.
Reserve Bank of India keeps the repo rate unchanged at 6.5 percent in its Monetary Policy Committee meeting.
Aliens have officially landed in New Delhi according to local news footage.
